text.tspan: Complete action / recipient / source cut / cost bound / finite lease
Memory release and cost settlement differ
One semantic message slot and one application writer per stream; other producers stage inert data.
Pre-cut range authority can outlive a seal observation. Unknown prefixes and costs never recreate send rights or free capacity.
